name: Jim Bedient's Blueberry Patch
description: Jim Bedient's Blueberry Patch is a family-run farm in Branchport, NY. It grows Strawberries and Blueberries, with seasonal availability through spring and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
